The '''Security Guard''' was a division of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. They served as the planetary militia and [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]].

==Organization==
[[File:NabooSecurityGuard-SWCTP.png|thumb|left|150px|[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Tobias Pall]], with a CR-2 heavy blaster pistol]]
The Security Guard corps was composed of somewhere between five and six thousand men and women as of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], though this number was commonly raised during [[Time/Legends|times]] of tension in the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal Court]]. Many Security Guards were natives of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] who had performed off-world military service, though it was known for [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] or businesspeople to receive martial training within the Security Guard before joining its ranks. Training was roughly similar to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] standard for a local [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]].

Security Guards commonly served as sentries and patrolmen in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], and the group was adept at handling riots and other civic disturbances, though military analysts did not believe the corps could defend Naboo against a military ground assault&mdash;such as that performed by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. Security Guards commonly served fifteen [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] on average, and most tended to remain with the unit for two [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. They were outfitted with a [[Color/Legends|yellow-and-brown]] armored uniform, and carried [[CR-2 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|CR-2 heavy blaster pistols]], though in times of peril, the guards were equipped with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]]. Sometime between [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] and [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Security Guards adopted a darker uniform.

==History==
[[File:NabooSecurityGuards_flash.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Two Security Guards piloting a [[Seraph-class urban landspeeder|Flash speeder]] during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].]]
Following the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Veruna]], the Security Guard quelled uprisings by elements of the [[Ralthar Syndicate]]. Prior to and during the Trade Federation invasion, the Security Guard was led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]]. Though unable to withstand the invasion of Naboo, the Security Guard assisted underground resistance movements, and fought in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].

Two prominent guards were killed in an [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] on [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] when their [[J-type diplomatic barge/Legends|ship]] returned with her to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] vote on the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]]. Rumors that the guard shown below standing in the ship was a suicide bomber were false, as the terrorist responsible for murdering the guards and Amidala's [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaiden]] [[Cordé/Legends|Cordé]] was in fact [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]], who worked for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] via fellow bounty hunter [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].
